item1.justification: The trace correctly applies §103 Graham/KSR factors (scope and content, differences, PHOSITA level, secondary considerations) for obviousness rejections and §112(a) written description framework for the QCI=1 claims, with no statute-mixing errors.

item2.justification: Conclusions throughout the trace consistently reference specific claim elements, named prior art references (US-2016140851-A1, US-2016274578-A1), specific paragraph and figure citations (¶0024–0027, FIG. 4), and concrete technical features like QCI values and flight risk maps.
